docs.text: Welcome to MkDocs For full documentation visit mkdocs.org . Main Page Commands mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project. mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server. mkdocs build - Build the documentation site. mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit. Project layout mkdocs.yml # The configuration file. docs/ index.md # The documentation homepage. ... # Other markdown pages, images and other files. Info Page This repo contains all the main data for the portswigger web security academy and this will be the landing page Link to SQl Injection
